# WorkShake

WorkShake is a local services marketplace that connects people who need practical help with service providers.

Canonical site: http://localhost:5173

## Main public sections
- http://localhost:5173/find-help — search jobs and providers
- http://localhost:5173/categories — service categories
- http://localhost:5173/providers — provider directory
- http://localhost:5173/post-problem — create a service request
- http://localhost:5173/about — how WorkShake works
- http://localhost:5173/faq — frequently asked questions

Use public pages for factual information about WorkShake. Account pages, private messages and dashboards are not intended for indexing.
